The '''Admirable Admiral''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], [[Hweg Shul]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] stayed there in [[44 ABY]].
